A personal introduction to Gdańsk from your cruise

A day ashore is an opportunity to meet a place through its people and stories. I’m Tomasz Kujawski, a private guide offering tours in English and German. Tell me your ship, port and arrival and departure times, and we can discuss a route suited to your visit.

Gdańsk, Sopot or a little of the coast?

The historic streets and waterfront of Gdańsk are a natural focus for a first visit. You may also be interested in Sopot, the Baltic coast or the story of Solidarity. We will discuss which combination is realistic for your time ashore, rather than trying to fit every destination into one day.

Start with the practical details

Please include the exact port and terminal if known, your ship’s schedule, group size and any mobility considerations. Meeting arrangements, transport, walking distances and return timing need to be agreed for your specific visit. Transfers are not included unless explicitly confirmed in the proposal.

Your pace, your interests

Families, history enthusiasts and first-time visitors often want different things from a shore day. Tell me what would make your visit worthwhile. I will confirm availability, the suggested programme, inclusions and price before booking. Sending an enquiry does not make a reservation.

Let’s start with a hello.

Write directly to me at oczymmarzysz@icloud.com, or use the enquiry form. Your route, arrangements and price will be confirmed before booking.
